decisions.reason: This coolant pressure booster system fits directly into our core coolant-management portfolio and supports our strategy of offering modular, efficient production solutions to existing metalworking customers.

This coolant cleaning centrifuge strengthens our established filtration and process-media offering and is well aligned with customer demand for productivity, sustainability and reliable system performance.
These coolant nozzles are a natural add-on to our existing coolant systems, enable cross-selling and help round out a broad, application-specific product range.
The scraper belt chip conveyor is close to our established conveying and automation business and expands our ability to deliver complete material-flow and production-support solutions.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor builds on our established chip-handling offer and supports our positioning as a full-system supplier for efficient factory operations.
The hinged belt chip conveyor complements our conveyor portfolio and helps us serve a wider set of customer use cases without departing from our core engineering strengths.
